Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
Great question! Nelly ships internationally, but only to selected countries: most EU countries, plus the United Kingdom and Switzerland. Outside the EU, delivery is available only to the UK and Switzerland.
Where applicable, customs, import duties, and local VAT or sales tax aren’t included in the checkout price. These charges may be collected on delivery and are your responsibility. In the UK, only orders under £135 qualify for tax- and customs-free import. If fees aren’t paid, UPS will discard the parcel, and Nelly can’t refund the items.

t question! Standard shipping includes up to 3 business days for processing before your parcel ships. After dispatch, delivery usually takes:
